Akal Takht Expels SAD Leader Amarjit Singh Chawla

The Akal Takht has expelled Akali Dal (SAD) leader Amarjit Singh Chawla from the 'Khalsa Panth'. Granthi Malkit Singh was also expelled. The expulsion is reportedly over a rape accusation.
